goal: WG-305: a model for the seven Guards (rules <guard>_failures_keep_their_code, model guard_semantics)

components.summary: Seven native domain Guards with one test-only good/bad case catalog.
responsibilities: Own native event, agent, space, resource, causal, conflict and norm rules
Preserve exact native failure codes and real good/bad regression inputs in tests
Each Guard's catalog good case passes and each catalog bad case fails with exactly its native code (model guard_semantics)
side_effects: Return native Guard results; family checks execute finite good and known-bad cases
